customManagers.description: The Godot release .godot-version pins. A bump also needs `python3 tools/godot.py pin`, which tests/test_flake.py asks for.

packageRules.description: A Godot bump waits on hold for the checks #133 set for one, which CI can't run, so the steward doesn't merge it on CI alone.
prBodyNotes: This bump keeps the `hold` label until the checks [#133](https://github.com/TusanHomichi/PSIV/issues/133) sets for a Godot bump pass on this head. `python3 tools/godot.py pin` writes the new version's downloads first.

packageRules.description: The release workflow builds Linux on the oldest Ubuntu runner GitHub offers on purpose: a build on a newer one links newer glibc symbol versions, and the Steam Deck refuses to load the extension (docs/DEVELOPMENT.md, tools/package/release.py). It moves when GitHub retires the runner, by hand and checked on a Deck, not by a Renovate bump.
